title: Supervising Security Operations
overview: This course is designed to equip security operatives, officers, and managers with the essential skills for conducting effective security operations. It covers a wide range of topics to help participants understand and apply the necessary skills required for day-to-day security duties. Participants will gain practical techniques and knowledge that can be immediately implemented in their workplace.
audience: This course is intended for security officers, managers, team leaders, and other personnel responsible for performing or managing security roles in various settings.
methodology: The course is highly interactive, incorporating group discussions, case studies, syndicate work, and practical exercises. These activities enable participants to apply the knowledge gained and demonstrate their skills in performing effective security operations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Demonstrate and explain the essential skills and duties of a confident security officer.
Understand and explain the relevant legislation and laws that impact security operations.
Emphasize the importance of emergency procedures in the workplace.
List key safety principles, procedures, and policies required for a secure workplace.
Apply effective communication, customer care, and negotiation skills.
Use searching, patrolling, and scene preservation techniques.
Describe the role of access and egress control in security operations.
